fields.name: principal_id
fields.note: the authorization_principal, 1 to 512 bytes, byte for byte

fields.name: selector
fields.note: a resource prefix, optionally ending in /*

fields.name: resource_types
fields.note: at least one registered type, or *

fields.name: revision
fields.note: the store revision of the last transition of this grant

fields.name: status
fields.note: active, revoked or expired; revoked and expired are terminal

fields.name: expires_at
fields.note: seconds since the epoch, UTC; absent means never

fields.name: operation_id
fields.note: exactly 16 bytes: the security mutation that issued it (WP-3.6); absent on a grant issued before
